gloss: to worship, to pray, to bow in reverence

definitions.explanation: To show religious reverence by bowing or pressing palms together.
To earnestly request something from someone.
To have the honor of seeing something (humble expression).

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{拝|おが}む。
examples.english: I press my hands together and pray at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうか→どうか：09854_douka⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願いします：00981_onegaishimasu⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{拝|おが}んだ。
⟦{初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}→初日の出：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝|おが}む。
examples.english: I view the first sunrise of the year.

notes:
{拝|おが}む means to worship or show reverence by pressing palms together or bowing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {仏|ほとけ}を{拝|おが}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手|て}を{合|あ}わせて{拝|おが}む: to pray with hands together
- {仏|ほとけ}を{拝|おが}む: to worship Buddha
- {初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}を{拝|おが}む: to view the first sunrise

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese people {拝|おが}む at temples and shrines. At Buddhist temples, one puts palms together; at Shinto shrines, one claps twice before praying.
